default.text: Ah, Kai-Jax. The Memory Weave connects us all. Seek wisdom, and you shall find strength.

options.text: Tell me about the Memory Weave.
I'm ready for my next task.

memory_weave_explanation.text: The Memory Weave binds our reality. It is both gift and burden. As your tails grow, so too does your connection to it—and the weight you must bear.

quest_check.text: Your determination is admirable. Let me see what tasks await you.

farewell.text: May the ancestors guide your path, young one.

4.override_dialogue: I see your fourth tail has emerged. The Memory Weave recognizes your growth.

5.override_dialogue: Five tails... You are becoming a force to be reckoned with. The city will remember your name.

6.override_dialogue: Six tails. Few have reached such heights. Even I feel the weight of your presence.

7.override_dialogue: Seven... The legends spoke of such power. I am honored to stand before you.

8.override_dialogue: *Eyes wide with awe* Eight tails. You are approaching divinity. I... I barely know how to speak to you anymore.

9.override_dialogue: *Kneels, trembling* Nine tails... The Crown of Memory. I am not worthy.
